description: This PHP source file defines the class AOR_Chart, which is a part of the SuiteCRM module for managing and rendering various types of charts (bar, line, pie, radar) using different chart libraries. It includes methods for building chart images and HTML snippets, handling chart data, configurations, and colors.

classes.name: AOR_Chart
classes.description: Represents a chart object within the SuiteCRM module, capable of generating various chart types and rendering them as HTML or images, with configuration options for colors, data, and visual styles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AOR_Chart object and sets default color palette.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Saves chart line configurations based on POST data, creating, updating, or deleting linked chart beans.

methods.name: getValidChartTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of valid chart types supported by the class.

methods.name: getColour
methods.description: Generates color schemes based on a seed string, either returning RGB values or color arrays.

methods.name: buildChartImage
methods.description: Builds a chart image using the pChart library based on report data and chart configuration.

methods.name: buildChartHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML code for embedding the chart using Chart.js or other libraries based on report data.

methods.name: buildChartHTMLPChart
methods.description: Creates an HTML image element for the chart with a linked image map for interactivity.

methods.name: buildChartHTMLChartJS
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript code to render the chart using Chart.js library.

methods.name: buildChartHTMLRGraph
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript to render RGraph charts based on report data.

methods.name: buildChartImageBar
methods.description: Creates a bar chart image using the pChart library.

methods.name: buildChartImagePie
methods.description: Creates a pie chart image using the pChart library.

methods.name: buildChartImageLine
methods.description: Creates a line chart image using the pChart library.

methods.name: buildChartImageRadar
methods.description: Creates a radar chart image using the pChart library.

methods.name: getRGraphRoseChart
methods.description: Returns HTML for rendering a Rose (polar) chart via RGraph library.

methods.name: getRGraphGroupedBarChart
methods.description: Returns HTML for rendering a grouped or stacked bar chart via RGraph library.

methods.name: getRGraphBarChart
methods.description: Returns HTML for rendering a bar chart via RGraph library.

methods.name: getRGraphRadarChart
methods.description: Returns HTML for rendering a radar chart via RGraph library.

methods.name: getRGraphPieChart
methods.description: Returns HTML for rendering a pie chart via RGraph library.

methods.name: getRGraphLineChart
methods.description: Returns HTML for rendering a line chart via RGraph library.

methods.name: getRGraphGroupedBarChartData
methods.description: Prepares data for grouped or stacked bar charts for RGraph.

methods.name: getRGraphBarChartData
methods.description: Prepares data for bar charts for RGraph.

methods.name: getBarChartData
methods.description: Prepares data structure for Chart.js bar chart.

methods.name: getLineChartData
methods.description: Prepares data for Chart.js line chart.

methods.name: getGroupedBarChartConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration array for grouped bar charts (currently default).

methods.name: getStackedBarChartConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration array for stacked bar charts (currently default).

methods.name: getBarChartConfig
methods.description: Returns default configuration array for bar charts.

methods.name: getLineChartConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration array for line charts.

methods.name: getRadarChartData
methods.description: Prepares data for radar charts.

methods.name: getRadarChartConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration array for radar charts.

methods.name: getPieChartConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration array for pie charts.

methods.name: getPieChartData
methods.description: Prepares data array for pie charts.
